task_names.self_action: Flight Behavior Recognition and Temporal Localization
task_names.env_visibility: Landmark Visibility Counting and Interval Reasoning

human.inclusion_rule: Completed both image and video assignments

open_ended_validation.missing_response_policy: Unreturned image responses are excluded from the reported completed-prediction denominator and are not silently imputed as errors.

qualitative_cases.selection_note: Original Figure 4 case: predicted count 1 and interval [0.5, 24.8] for GT [0.0, 25.0].

additional_validation.note: A missing value means that the model was not applicable to that modality in this validation.

definitions.dual_semantic_acc: P(agent semantic correct AND world semantic correct) on paired samples
definitions.dual_grounding_acc: P(agent semantic correct AND world semantic correct AND agent grounding >= 0.5 AND world grounding >= 0.5) on paired samples
definitions.joint_localization_acc: Diagnostic only: P(agent grounding >= 0.5 AND world grounding >= 0.5), without requiring semantic correctness
definitions.image_position_pair: same scene, landmark/view identifiers, and difficulty for self_where and env_where
definitions.image_action_observation_pair: same scene, landmark/view identifiers, and difficulty for self_what and env_how
definitions.video_pair: same source trajectory for self_action and env_visibility

parsing_policy.scope: Image grounding fields in the main result table; semantic and video metrics retain their original scoring definitions.
parsing_policy.scale_inference_level: One scale is inferred for a complete model run, never independently per sample.
accepted: JSON objects embedded in prose or Markdown fences after removing reasoning tags
documented BBox aliases: bbox_xyxy_norm, bbox, bounding_box, and box
singleton answers arrays containing one structured prediction
pixel BBoxes only when the complete run-wide range is consistent with the 640x480 input
reversed corner order after deterministic coordinate reordering
rejected: outputs without a recoverable JSON object
parsing_policy.audit_reporting: Both original and compatible parsing results are retained; no individual sample is repaired selectively.

coordination.aggregation: Equal task weights (four image tasks, one joint behavior task, one visibility task). Evidence is threshold success, not F1 or mean IoU.
coordination.missing_policy: Invalid outputs fail. Paired scores use all available aligned records and retain pair counts and full-coverage flags for audit; Human sampled assignments are not inferred from marginal scores.
coordination.duplicate_policy: Last stored record per sample within a named run; no best-of-retries or cross-run sample filling.
